svg.title: Endfield export and WebUI build workflow
svg.desc: Commands, page extraction scopes, build dependencies and the boundary of full supported coverage.

g.text: From installed Endfield data to the WebUI
export.bat selects page inputs; AnimeStudio extracts them; independent builders publish each page.
Rebuild every page from the existing export.
Extract every supported family, then rebuild every page.
Inspect scope, freshness requirements and tasks without running them.
VFS indexes for both installed layers
Newest overlay wins; resolve page scope
Media and raw payloads in their stores
Run ready tasks within the job limit
Each builder owns its page outputs
Plain export.bat starts at step 3. --changed-only refreshes changed structured files, then builds every page.
Grouped cells show any matching input. Hover a cell for exact class/block names.

g.title: story-media — O: audit-video, video; U: audit-video, video
data — O: dynamic-streaming; F: audit-dynamic-streaming, audit-iv, audit-streaming, bundle-manifest, dynamic-streaming, extend-data, i-fix-patch, initial-extend-data, iv, streaming
data — O: MonoBehaviour, PlayableDirector; F: MonoBehaviour, PlayableDirector

data — O: AnimatorController, AnimatorOverrideController; F: AnimatorController, AnimatorOverrideController, AssetBundle, AvatarMask, IndexObject, MonoScript, NapAssetBundleIndexAsset, PlayerSettings, PreloadData, ResourceManager, SpriteAtlas

g.text: VFS metadata is always indexed during extraction; carrier JSON runs also publish the object index.
R / O / F enter the --from-game scope. U is extracted only when another selected page owns it.
production builds the catalog shown inside Gameplay. Story media adds images/video; Audio publishes voice sidecars.
Earliest dependency depth; tasks start as their inputs succeed (default: 4 concurrent builders).
A standalone page builds its own tasks and reads other pages' last publications.
Audio → Story voices · Story → Characters appearances · Assets → Map textures · Data → Gameplay / Map evidence
All pages equal the supported full extraction scope. Debug adds broader asset indexing and Sprite image checks.
Decoded blocks → game/; packed small files → GameFiles.sqlite; exact Unity documents → Unity.sqlite; raw families → raw/.
Raw payloads and excluded Unity objects retain their evidence boundary; extraction does not recover every runtime meaning.
The wrapper publishes CN and decodes CN audio. Updates separately compares two complete export trees.
Generated from scripts/webui/pages.py and extraction/scope.py · python -m scripts.webui.export_diagram
